ONC's yfinance dividend series is empty, so the app honestly states 'insufficient dividend-history depth to affirm a trailing-12m zero' rather than fabricating a zero. Per the diff rules that is an honest labelled gap, not a finding.

reason: The mismatch is a horizon (definitional) difference, not a same-definition divergence. yfinance's forwardPE is price / forwardEps, and forwardEps = the '+1y' (next fiscal year, FY2027) consensus of 10.3176 across 17 analysts: 368.08 / 10.3176 = 35.68, matching the live forward_pe 35.675. Stockanalysis's 43.91 implies EPS ~7.99, which fits the current-year '0y' consensus (7.60) or an NTM blend. Two different estimate horizons, so no wrong value. What survives is the labelling point: field_meta marks forward_pe 'ok' with no estimate horizon or consensus provenance, so a user cannot tell why it disagrees ~20% with other sources. A low-severity labelling gap.
